ASV10b-P4-Q3.why: One grader (probable): a porous panel with a 50 mm air space should peak near 1.4 kHz and dip near 2.7 kHz (quarter/half-wave), so a dip at 1 kHz runs against the simple model. Coordinator: the quarter-wave picture is a first-order approximation and Material V is invented; the table is unusual for real porous absorbers but not physically impossible, so R3 (impossibility) is not met. No effect on the outcome: sc10b-p4 drops under R6 (ASV10b-P4-Q5, both graders).
